title: Delicious Weeknight Pregnancy Menus: 5 Cook-Once Recipes
excerpt: Five flavorful recipes for busy evenings — soup, stir-fry, egg dishes and yogurt parfaits — balanced for protein, fiber and calcium.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, eating a balanced and nutritious diet is crucial to ensure the health of both mother and baby. However, with busy lives, many pregnant women struggle to prepare healthy and delicious meals. In this article, we will introduce 5 cook-once recipes to help pregnant women have healthy and delicious weeknight meals.

## Nutrient Analysis
The recipes below are chosen to provide enough protein, fiber, and calcium for pregnant women. Protein helps build and repair body tissues, fiber supports digestive health, and calcium helps develop the baby's bones and teeth.

## 5 Cook-Once Recipes
### 1. Chicken Soup with Vegetables
Chicken soup is a delicious and easy-to-make dish. To cook chicken soup, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, such as parsley and cilantro

Cooking chicken soup with vegetables will provide enough protein, fiber, and vitamins for pregnant women.

### 2. Stir-Fried Chicken with Vegetables
Stir-fried chicken with vegetables is a great option for weeknight meals. To cook stir-fried chicken, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, such as parsley and cilantro

Stir-fried chicken with vegetables will provide enough protein, fiber, and vitamins for pregnant women.

### 3. Poached Eggs with Salad
Poached eggs are a delicious and easy-to-make dish. To cook poached eggs, you need:
- 2 eggs
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 1 teaspoon of oil
- Fresh herbs, such as parsley and cilantro
- Salad (lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers)

Poached eggs with salad will provide enough protein, fiber, and vitamins for pregnant women.

### 4. Yogurt Parfait with Fruit
Yogurt parfait with fruit is a healthy and delicious dessert. To make yogurt parfait, you need:
- 1 cup of yogurt
- 1 apple
- 1 banana
- 1 orange
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 1 teaspoon of oil

Yogurt parfait with fruit will provide enough calcium, fiber, and vitamins for pregnant women.

### 5. Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
Chicken and vegetable fried rice is a delicious and easy-to-make dish. To cook chicken and vegetable fried rice, you need:
- 1 chicken
- 2 carrots
- 2 potatoes
- 1 onion
- 2 cloves of garlic
- 1 teaspoon of salt
- 1 teaspoon of sugar
- 2 teaspoons of fish sauce
- 2 teaspoons of oil
- Fresh herbs, such as parsley and cilantro

Chicken and vegetable fried rice will provide enough protein, fiber, and vitamins for pregnant women.

## Practical Tips
- Choose fresh and clean ingredients to ensure food safety.
- Cook with healthy oils, such as olive or sunflower oil.
- Add fresh herbs, such as parsley and cilantro, to dishes to increase flavor and nutrition.
- Drink enough water and eat enough meals to ensure the health of both mother and baby.

## When to Seek Help
If you have any questions or concerns about your diet or health, consult with your doctor or a registered dietitian for advice.
